name: m-techlabs-desktop
description: MTerm-CLI owner-managed workstation tools with engineering and operations controls.

interface.longDescription: MTerm-CLI connects to Dylan's private, owner-authenticated managed Desktop Commander bridge. In addition to file, search and terminal functions, the manager offers bounded math, system and Hyper-V inspection, repository diagnostics, approved tests and a durable job queue. New execution and VM power operations require explicit capability permission and the global write gate. Control fleet concurrency (1–64 active calls), toolkit switches and jobs at M-TechLabs.com/admin/mcp. Repository paths stay local; connected chats and other hosted accounts remain separate. The standalone MTerm-CLI staging codebase has not replaced this proven bridge. The PC must be on and the manager running.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MTerm-CLI to verify my managed workstation tools and help me safely work on my PC.
